# Code-Only Motion Design Pipeline , launch films and promos in pure HTML/JS

Curated by Skill Harbor: a code-only motion design pipeline for launch films, showreels and promos with zero After Effects: brief, beat map synced to the music drop, stills first, then a deterministic seek(t) HTML engine rendered frame by frame with Playwright, ffmpeg encode, Mixkit music and SFX placed on exact frames, and a motion-critic loop that scores every film until each category hits 8+. by @howseen-ai, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: this is the creator's personal battle-tested pipeline, tuned on his own films: paths, brand assets and some defaults assume his setup, so expect adaptation work to make it yours; needs Playwright, ffmpeg and Python, all free. Replaces Blender/After Effects with reproducible code and Higgsfield/Suno with free stock. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via GitHub.
